_purpose: Date-specific observances relevant to home service contractors that the Researcher/Generator check each week via lib/calendar.js + lib/planner.js. Molly has no seasonal campaign mode (no September ramp / October daily cadence like Miley) — every matching entry becomes extra angle context folded into that week's prompts, never a format/slot override, since Molly's 4-post schedule is fixed.

_rule_types.nth_weekday_of_month: { month: 1-12, weekday: 'SUN'..'SAT', n: 1-5 } — e.g. n:1, weekday:'WED', month:5 = first Wednesday in May.
_rule_types.first_full_week_of_month: { month: 1-12 } — the first Mon-Sun week fully contained in that month.
_rule_types.monthly_day: { day: 1-28 } — fires every month on that calendar day.
_rule_types.explicit_range: { start: 'YYYY-MM-DD', end: 'YYYY-MM-DD' } — hardcoded for a single year. Source-announced dates move yearly — re-verify and update before each occurrence; see 'reverify_note'.

entries.name: National Skilled Trades Day
entries.angle: National Skilled Trades Day (first Wednesday in May) — a built-in excuse to talk up the trades and the people in them. Good day for a pride/education angle, not a sales push.
entries.source: National Day Calendar (confirmed annual: first Wednesday in May)

entries.name: National Small Business Week
entries.angle: National Small Business Week — most contractors ARE the small business it's honoring. Good angle for the caption or carousel slot: what it actually takes to run the business side of a trade, not just do the work.
entries.source: U.S. Small Business Administration (confirmed annual: first full week of May)

entries.name: New year / new season planning window
entries.angle: Early January — contractors are planning the year's marketing budget and slow-season projects. Good window for an education angle about getting found online before the busy season starts.
entries.source: Seasonal — contractor booking cycles slow in winter across most trades except HVAC (excluded)
entries.reverify_note: Hardcoded for 2026 only — shift the date range forward each year.

entries.name: Spring home-improvement season kickoff
entries.angle: First Monday in March — homeowners start planning spring projects and searching for contractors again after the winter lull. Good angle for a results/education post about being findable when search volume picks up.
entries.source: Seasonal — general home-improvement search-volume pattern, no specific stat cited

entries.name: Monthly online-presence check-in
entries.angle: The 1st of the month is a natural low-key reminder day: a gentle nudge to check how your business actually looks to someone searching for you right now (Google listing, reviews, whether you even have a site).
entries.source: General practice — no statistic attached, framed as a habit prompt not a claim
